summary.critical_finding: TWO SEPARATE CAPABILITY NAMESPACES DETECTED - Domain CAPABILITIES vs Entitlement Capability enum

items.blocker_reason: DECISION_CREATE exists in services/entitlement.ts Capability enum but NOT in domain/constants/capabilities.ts. Two capability namespaces create inconsistency and security risk.
items.recommended_mapping: Add DECISION_CREATE to domain CAPABILITIES as 'decision:create'. Map entitlement Capability.DECISION_CREATE to domain CAPABILITIES.DECISION_CREATE.

items.blocker_reason: Same as decisions/create - missing DECISION_CREATE in domain CAPABILITIES

items.current_pattern: Domain CAPABILITIES check via legacy requireCapabilityForService
items.blocker_reason: Stage operations are governance-dependent but not represented in entitlements. Stage creation affects intervention phase lifecycle.
items.recommended_mapping: Map STAGE_CREATE to entitlements if stage creation is plan-gated, or keep domain-only if always allowed.

items.current_pattern: Domain CAPABILITIES check via legacy requireCapabilityForService
items.blocker_reason: Read operation, lower risk. Not plan-gated in entitlements.
items.recommended_mapping: Keep domain-only. Stage reads don't need entitlement gating.

items.current_pattern: Domain CAPABILITIES check via legacy requireCapabilityForService
items.blocker_reason: Stage transitions modify engagement state (isBlocked) and affect intervention phase. Governance-critical but not in entitlements.
items.recommended_mapping: Determine if stage transitions should be plan-gated. If yes, add to entitlements. If no, keep domain-only.

items.blocker_reason: Dashboard aggregates governance-aware data from multiple services. Currently requires ENGAGEMENT_VIEW. Unclear if plan-gated in entitlements.
items.recommended_mapping: Clarify if engagement dashboard is plan-gated. If yes, add to entitlements as ENGAGEMENT_DASHBOARD_VIEW. If no, keep domain-only.

items.current_pattern: Domain CAPABILITIES check via withCanonicalEnforcement wrapper
items.blocker_reason: Workspace-level owner dashboard. Separate from engagement dashboard. Requires OWNER_VIEW capability.
items.recommended_mapping: Clarify owner mode entitlements. If plan-gated, add OWNER_VIEW and OWNER_MANAGE to entitlements.

items.current_pattern: Domain CAPABILITIES check via withCanonicalEnforcement wrapper
items.blocker_reason: Owner configuration affects workspace governance settings. Should be entitlement-checked.
items.recommended_mapping: Add OWNER_MANAGE to entitlements if plan-gated. Clarify whether owner mode is tier-specific.

items.current_pattern: Entitlement enum, separate from domain CAPABILITIES
items.blocker_reason: CRITICAL GAP: decision_create is in entitlements but NOT in domain CAPABILITIES. Creates two separate capability namespaces.
items.recommended_mapping: MUST add DECISION_CREATE to domain CAPABILITIES as 'decision:create' and unify namespaces.

items.current_pattern: Entitlement enum, separate from domain CAPABILITIES
items.blocker_reason: CRITICAL GAP: decision_update is in entitlements but NOT in domain CAPABILITIES. No corresponding domain capability.
items.recommended_mapping: MUST add DECISION_UPDATE to domain CAPABILITIES as 'decision:update' and unify namespaces.

items.current_pattern: Entitlement enum, separate from domain CAPABILITIES
items.blocker_reason: Experiment operations are entitlement-gated but not in domain CAPABILITIES. Unclear if there are routes using this.
items.recommended_mapping: Add EXPERIMENT_CREATE to domain CAPABILITIES if experiments are runtime-enforced. Otherwise keep entitlement-only.

items.current_pattern: Entitlement enum, not in domain CAPABILITIES
items.blocker_reason: Admin capabilities exist in entitlements but not domain CAPABILITIES. Unclear routing.
items.recommended_mapping: Determine if ADMIN_* operations need domain CAPABILITIES or stay entitlement-only.

items.blocker_reason: Decision accept/reject are in domain CAPABILITIES but not in entitlement enum. Asymmetry with CREATE/UPDATE.
items.recommended_mapping: Consider adding DECISION_ACCEPT and DECISION_REJECT to entitlements, or leave as domain-only if not plan-gated.

items.blocker_reason: Intervention operations are domain-gated but not in entitlements. Unclear if plan-specific.
items.recommended_mapping: Clarify if intervention management should be plan-gated. If yes, add to entitlements.

items.blocker_reason: Dashboard aggregates governance-dependent data (findings, recommendations, actions, condition profile, execution metrics). Requires ENGAGEMENT_VIEW, not a dedicated dashboard capability.
items.recommended_mapping: Determine if dashboard aggregation requires separate governance capability or if ENGAGEMENT_VIEW is sufficient.

critical_findings.evidence: Domain CAPABILITIES (domain/constants/capabilities.ts) format 'domain:action' vs Entitlement Capability (services/entitlement.ts) format 'action_operation'
critical_findings.impact: Security risk - capabilities are checked against different enums depending on route/service
critical_findings.must_resolve_before: Any further governance or service refactoring

critical_findings.finding: DECISION_CREATE and DECISION_UPDATE missing from domain CAPABILITIES
critical_findings.evidence: decisions/create/route.ts checks assertCapability(workspaceId, 'decision_create') but CAPABILITIES.DECISION_CREATE does not exist in domain/constants/capabilities.ts
critical_findings.impact: Decision creation routes use entitlement-only checks, not runtime domain capabilities. Cannot be migrated to ServiceAuthEnvelope without DECISION_CREATE in domain CAPABILITIES.

critical_findings.finding: Stage operations are domain-gated but not entitlement-gated
critical_findings.evidence: stage.ts uses domain CAPABILITIES (STAGE_CREATE, STAGE_TRANSITION, STAGE_VIEW) but services/entitlement.ts has no stage capabilities
critical_findings.impact: Stage operations are not quota-controlled. Cannot determine if stage creation/transition should be plan-specific.

critical_findings.finding: Dashboard aggregation has unclear governance mapping
critical_findings.evidence: owner-dashboard.service.ts aggregates data from 6 governance-aware services but only checks ENGAGEMENT_VIEW capability
critical_findings.impact: Dashboard capability requirements may be insufficient for governance-aware aggregation. Unclear if plan-specific.
